entities.summary: Maati Bouabid was a politician and a lawyer who served as the Prime Minister of Morocco between March 22, 1979, and November 30, 1983. He was the ninth Prime Minister of Morocco and served under king Hassan II. He also served as the Minister of Labor and Social Affairs from 1968 to 1970 and Minister of Justice.
